title: JUPITER magic-state cultivation review: original figure provenance

hero.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished editorial cover for a scholarly physics and technology review, wide 16:9 landscape, high resolution.
Primary request: Make a beautiful, scientifically disciplined conceptual artwork about the SAME storage place being used, released after measurement, and then used again at a later time. This temporal reuse is the one main event. It illustrates a classical state-vector simulation schedule, not a physical quantum computer and not data.
Scene and subject: An elegant sculptural paper construction on a warm ivory ground. Three thin translucent vellum sheets are suspended in a shallow, gently oblique exploded view, staggered from rear-left to front-right as successive time stages. Each sheet has the same sparse orderly array of architectural rectangular bays, precisely aligned with faint graphite registration guides across time. Focus on ONE corresponding central bay repeated across the three layers: on the rear-left sheet a small sculptural vermilion folded-paper loop occupies that bay; on the middle sheet that very bay is conspicuously empty, a clean luminous vacancy with its contour still visible; on the front-right sheet the same bay is occupied anew by a differently folded vermilion loop. The middle vacancy must be visually unmistakable and remain unobstructed. Other sparse graphite elements quietly retain their places. A few tiny discrete graphite stitch marks leave the first stage and continue along a fine line outside the bays toward the right, a subtle metaphor for persisting classical measurement records; do not draw a duplicate of the loop along this record line.
Style and medium: Original sophisticated editorial paper collage and fine dry graphite drawing, tactile archival paper fibers, careful cut edges, translucent overlays, restrained geometric precision, deep artistic judgment, subtle imperfect handmade texture. Contemporary museum print quality. No imitation of a named artist or publication.
Composition: One calm unified sculptural scene, not a three-panel infographic. Wide 16:9 framing, generous clean negative space, strong single focal progression occupied-empty-reoccupied. Large simple forms readable at thumbnail size. The sheets share one consistent perspective and one consistent set of bay registrations. Reuse through time must be clearer than any decorative complexity.
Lighting and palette: Diffuse raking daylight, delicate graphite shadows, warm ivory and pale grey paper with a very small but deliberate cinnabar/vermilion accent. A quiet, analytical and poetic atmosphere.
Text: None.
Scientific invariants: The vacant middle bay represents released storage ONLY AFTER a measurement, not squeezing or copying an unknown quantum state. The artwork must not imply arbitrary compression of a 104-qubit state into 45 qubits. The array sizes and folds have no quantitative meaning. This is a temporal conceptual metaphor, not a simulation plot, not an exact circuit, and not a device rendering.
Avoid: Text, letters, numerals, labels, arrows, equations, chart axes, logos, watermark, exact qubit counts, binary code, circuit-board motifs, blue or neon glow, server racks, cryostats, stars, planets, brains, robots, many objects funneling into a smaller box, mystical entanglement clouds, metallic science-fiction gloss. Do not show objects being compressed. No people.
hero.processing: Original PNG preserved. RGB WebP derivative resampled to 1664 × 936 for the existing 16:9 cover slot; no artistic compositing or content edits.
hero.claim: Translucent paper layers represent successive times; the vermilion folds and intervening vacancy symbolize storage being released after measurement and reused later. Fine dotted traces stand for retained classical measurement records. AI-generated conceptual illustration, not an exact circuit, qubit count, or simulation data.

scientific_invariants: Storage reuse follows measurement and release; the picture does not depict discarding arbitrary entangled live states.
The motif does not depict arbitrary compression of a 104-qubit state into 45 qubits.
The repeated sheets mean time, not three physical processors or separate spatial registers.
Grid size, fold shape, number of dots, and distances have no quantitative meaning.
The classical record motif is distinct from the reused storage motif.
This is conceptual editorial art, not an exact circuit, device photograph, plotted data, or measured performance.

deterministic_figures.method: Original explanatory schematic and independent complex128 state-vector memory calculation. Matplotlib SVG with outlined text.
deterministic_figures.basis: Reported 104 physical data/auxiliary positions over the whole protocol, live binary-encoded 45-bit register and 512 TiB state vector. Source encoding example: 5 qutrits -> 243 basis states -> 8 binary bits. Exact qubit:qutrit split of the actual live register is not disclosed.
deterministic_figures.claim: The source quantities count different things; release/reuse/reordering is not physical compression of an arbitrary simultaneous 104-qubit state. The curve M(n)=16*2^n bytes is a teaching calculation excluding workspace, communication buffers and runtime overhead.

deterministic_figures.method: Original schematic with deliberately generic patch motifs; no source circuit image is reproduced. Matplotlib SVG with outlined text.
deterministic_figures.basis: Source stages: distance-3 color code, additional flag checks, distance-7 hybrid color/surface code, correction rounds and readout. Rejection/retry explains the cultivation concept.
deterministic_figures.claim: Patch motifs are not an exact code layout or gate schedule. Downstream consumption of accepted magic states via Clifford gates, measurement and feedforward is conceptually connected but lies outside the reported JUPITER measurement scope.

deterministic_figures.method: Original generic educational diagrams of coherent phase rotation, stochastic Pauli dephasing, and a three-level system with a qubit computational subspace. Matplotlib SVG with outlined text.
deterministic_figures.basis: The technical source reports coherent phase errors and selected superconducting-site third-level leakage; it does not publish a full channel matrix, rates or relaxation parameters.
deterministic_figures.claim: Rz(theta), the Pauli mixture with probability p and the |1><->|2> arrow are generic teaching models. They do not reproduce the run's channels, measured events or fitted parameters. No quantitative error-performance curve is fabricated.

equation_rendering.method: Static MathJax SVG; no browser-side external math service.

typography.method: Openly licensed Nanum Gothic subsets renamed Review Sans Subset; complete OFL retained and embedded with the public stylesheet.

distribution.allowed: Final HTML/PDF, conceptual hero, referenced original explanatory and equation SVGs, CSS with embedded local openly licensed fonts and their license.
distribution.excluded: Research notes, raw source captures, email data, screenshots, private host paths, build scripts and source Markdown, third-party full-text papers, and this provenance JSON.

independent_teaching_calculations.scope: Complex128 state-memory arithmetic at 40,45,46,50 bits; 64 GiB per GPU for state alone; 5-qutrit encoding; generic single-qubit coherent-vs-stochastic example. Not a JUPITER rerun or a cultivation-circuit error prediction.
independent_teaching_calculations.independent_checks: Repeated two-amplitude unitary evolution and an iterative two-state probability recurrence agree with the article closed forms. theta=0.01 radians and r=20: coherent 0.9966711079%, stochastic 0.04997584085%.
